nina: Heads-up 12h to webinar rehearsal. Need a quick validation run from eng/runtime: final launch benchmark with rdlw-3b-quant-v3 (the newest quant pack) using the "webinar-final" prompt set. Deliverables: p50/p95 tokens/s, coldstart heatmap, tiny CSV of per-request latencies, and a one-paragraph note if any requests hit fallback models. Also validate webhook lead routing to CRM sandbox (webhook id wf-sbx-2026) using the sample lead payloads in the drive. Can we get this within 6h? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
aj: We can do a fast spotprobe. Need confirmation of: model tag (rdlw-3b-quant-v3 ok), warmup profile, concurrency target, and whether to include an explicit cold-sweep (clear KV cache) for heatmap. Also which region should routing use (prod-dedicated us-west vs staging)?
sarah-mktg: Confirm model rdlw-3b-quant-v3 and warmup 40 requests @256 tokens (matches demo prompts). Concurrency 6, batch-cap 10. Use prod-dedicated us-west for routing test but point webhook at CRM sandbox so no real leads. Cold-sweep yes. Please redact any PII in artifacts. Need snappy summary for slides + CSV. :pray:
devon: Got it. Suggested run commands (minimal):
```
# spotprobe run example
spotprobe --model rdlw-3b-quant-v3 --prompts "webinar-final" --warmup 40 --concurrency 6 --batch-cap 10 --cold-sweep 25 --annotate webhook=wf-sbx-2026
```
Output: metrics.json, latencies.csv, coldstart-heatmap.png, routing-logs.json (headers redacted). We'll also emit a 2-3 line anomalies note if any fallback occurs.
bench-bot: Job scheduled: spotprobe-1765440002-fast started on node-d6 (quantized). ETA ~3h. Link: https://jobs.redwood/spotprobe/1765440002 :robot_face:
aj: Running now. We'll snapshot traces and routing headers (with token masked) and attach artifacts here when finished. If routing falls back to fp16 variant, we'll call it out explicitly and include exact request ids.
nina: Awesome, please tag me and sarah-mktg when artifacts are uploaded. If results show P95 > 800ms on production routing, hold the slide and ping me immediately. Also include a one-line note with token-cost estimate for the cohort. :money_with_wings:
